entities.summary: Barbara Cassin is a French philologist and philosopher. She was elected to the Académie Française on 4 May 2018. Cassin is the recipient of the Grand Prize of Philosophy of the Académie Française. She is an emeritus research director at the National Center for Scientific Research (CNRS) in Paris. She is a program director at the International College of Philosophy and the director of its Scientific Council and member of its board of directors. She was a director of Collège international de philosophie established by Jacques Derrida.
